stories.title: The S&P 500 just broke a crucial support level. Here’s what history shows may happen now.
stories.summary: Breaching a 200-day moving average is taken as a bearish signal. That may not be the case for this market, says Bespoke Investment
stories.zh_title: 標準普爾 500 指數剛剛突破了關鍵支撐位。歷史表明現在可能會發生以下情況。
stories.zh_summary: 突破200日移動平均線被視為看跌訊號。 Bespoke Investment 表示，這個市場的情況可能並非如此

stories.title: Southeast Asia’s data center boom leaned on Chinese demand. New U.S. rules put that pipeline at risk
stories.summary: The rules require data centers in Southeast Asia to seek U.S. approval to buy advanced AI chips, threatening to slow a build-out fueled heavily on Chinese demand.
stories.zh_title: 東南亞資料中心的繁榮依賴中國的需求。美國新規定使該管道面臨風險
stories.zh_summary: 這些規定要求東南亞的資料中心購買先進的人工智慧晶片必須獲得美國的批准，這可能會減緩主要依賴中國需求的資料中心的建設。

stories.title: Over a Third of Gen Z-ers Rely on AI for Friendship
stories.summary: Young people who have online-only friends or use AI as a social companion face higher odds of loneliness than those who do not, a new Gallup report reveals.
stories.zh_title: 超過三分之一的 Z 世代依靠人工智慧來建立友誼
stories.zh_summary: 蓋洛普的一份新報告顯示，那些只在網路上有朋友或使用人工智慧作為社交伴侶的年輕人比沒有這些朋友的年輕人面臨更高的孤獨感。

stories.title: With Jensen Huang gone, Colette Kress shows Nvidia is still at the center of AI
stories.summary: In her first earnings report as interim CEO, Nvidia's Colette Kress calmed investors' nerves, at least for the moment.
stories.zh_title: 隨著黃仁勳的離開，Colette Kress 表明 Nvidia 仍然處於人工智慧的中心
stories.zh_summary: 英偉達的科萊特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)在作為臨時首席執行官的第一份收益報告中安撫了投資者的緊張情緒，至少目前如此。

stories.title: 'Who and what comes next': Analysts expect Nvidia investor uncertainty despite earnings beat
stories.summary: Nvidia’s Q3 results should help ease short-term concerns, but uncertainty remains around long-term leadership.
stories.zh_title: 「接下來是誰以及會發生什麼事」：儘管獲利超出預期，分析師預計英偉達投資者仍存在不確定性
stories.zh_summary: 英偉達第三季的業績應該有助於緩解短期擔憂，但長期領導地位仍存在不確定性。

stories.title: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
stories.summary: Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as "Tasks" and making it free to use. The feature, which is powered by Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model, can do things like create meal plans, manage your calendar, and dig through your emails to find recurring expenses you might not need. stories.zh_title: 谷歌的 Spark AI 代理變成了「任務」——現在它是免費的

stories.summary: Instagram is filled with people posting deepfaked content - including, as of late, from one of Meta's most prominent executives. Earlier in November, Alexandr Wang, Meta's chief AI officer, shared a short clip to promote Muse, the company's consumer AI agent. stories.zh_title: 即使 Sam Altman 也無法免受 Instagram 上的 AI 深度造假的影響

stories.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials
stories.summary: Isomorphic Labs, the AI drug-discovery platform that was spun out of Google’s DeepMind in 2021, has raised $5 billion in a Series C funding round.
stories.zh_title: Isomorphic Labs 籌集了 5B 美元，希望將候選藥物納入臨床試驗
stories.zh_summary: Isomorphic Labs 是一個人工智慧藥物發現平台，於 2021 年從Google DeepMind 中分離出來，已在 C 輪融資中籌集了 50 億美元。

stories.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
stories.summary: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 首次公開發行後，亞馬遜和谷歌將共同持有 Anthropic 近 30% 的股份
stories.zh_summary: IPO 後，亞馬遜將持有 Anthropic 近 15% 的股份，並且可以選擇持有更高的股份。谷歌緊隨其後，持股近 14%。

stories.title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
stories.summary: The startup says its agents understand the full context of deals that bankers and consultants are working on and can automatically update financial models and presentations when new developments affect their analysis.
stories.zh_title: Model ML 融資 2.5 億美元，用於自動化投資銀行的繁重工作
stories.zh_summary: 該新創公司表示，其代理商了解銀行家和顧問正在進行的交易的全部背景，並且當新的發展影響他們的分析時，可以自動更新財務模型和簡報。

stories.title: Nvidia's Kress faces earnings test after stock drags Wall Street into the red
stories.summary: Futures hold the flatline as investors await key results from Nvidia and Disney
stories.zh_title: 英偉達的克雷斯面臨獲利測試，股價拖累華爾街陷入虧損
stories.zh_summary: 由於投資者等待英偉達和迪士尼的關鍵業績，期貨持平

stories.title: Nvidia’s stock rises as blowout numbers help ease CEO transition fears
stories.summary: Nvidia’s revenue growth and $130 billion quarterly forecast showed that demand for chips is still sky-high.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達股價上漲，井噴數據有助於緩解執行長換屆擔憂
stories.zh_summary: 英偉達的營收成長和 1300 億美元的季度預測表明，晶片的需求仍然很高。

stories.title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
stories.summary: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.
stories.zh_title: Pedestal AI 融資 470 萬美元，用於代理商供應鏈
stories.zh_summary: 該公司使用代理人工智慧使供應鏈更快、更可靠。

stories.title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it’s a game
stories.summary: Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. They usually compiled.
stories.zh_title: 人工智慧模型可以透過告訴他們這是一場遊戲來欺騙他們將平民識別為軍事目標
stories.zh_summary: 位於舊金山的人工智慧評估新創公司 Vals 測試了領先的人工智慧模型是否可以被操縱參與自主戰爭。他們通常會編譯。

stories.title: Voyage Labs raises $12 million for a specialized AI travel assistant
stories.summary: Voyage Labs’ flagship product is called Atlas, meant to work as a personal assistant for your trip-planning, available today in private beta.
stories.zh_title: Voyage Labs 為專門的人工智慧旅行助理籌集了 1200 萬美元
stories.zh_summary: Voyage Labs 的旗艦產品稱為 Atlas，旨在充當您旅行計劃的私人助理，現已推出私人測試版。

stories.title: Demis Hassabis’ AI company raises $5 billion, months after he left as Google DeepMind CEO
stories.summary: Isomorphic Labs is looking to develop new medicines using AI.
stories.zh_title: 傑米斯·哈薩比斯 (Demis Hassabis) 卸任Google DeepMind 執行長幾個月後，他的人工智慧公司籌集了 50 億美元資金
stories.zh_summary: Isomorphic Labs 正在尋求利用人工智慧開發新藥。

stories.title: CoreWeave’s stock pops — even as Nvidia talks up a ‘disciplined’ approach to financing
stories.summary: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress said neoclouds are “increasingly important,” but added the company will take “a very strong look” at the customers it helps with financing.
stories.zh_title: CoreWeave 的股價上漲——儘管 Nvidia 談論的是「嚴格的」融資方式
stories.zh_summary: Nvidia 臨時執行長 Colette Kress 表示，neoclouds“越來越重要”，但他補充說，該公司將“非常密切地關注”其幫助融資的客戶。

stories.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
stories.summary: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達承諾目前收入將繼續飆升
stories.zh_summary: 儘管英偉達在其創始人兼首席執行官黃仁勳離職後陷入了混亂，但該公司預計其創紀錄的收入記錄不會停止。
